failure.message: Route 11 supply Gambler status cure lacks its stable supported gate.

diagnosis.finding: Every Lavender trainer intent advertised HP, sleep, and paralysis recovery even when the supply-income battle explicitly allowed zero HP recoveries and occurred before the Mart purchase with only the protected final status-item reserve.
diagnosis.executor_behavior: The status-item executor correctly requires quantity greater than one so the final reserve cannot be consumed.
diagnosis.model_behavior: The controller selected a declared recovery action. Authorization accepted it because the static intent mask falsely said the effect was available.

repair.behavior: Recompute the BattleIntent recovery-capability mask before every battle-runtime dispatch from current inventory, protected status-item floors, remaining Super Potions, and the remaining per-battle HP allowance.
repair.safety_effect: Unavailable recovery is now masked before execution and falls back to the learned legal move path; protected inventory is never presented as spendable authority.
repair.rom_free_regression: The capability projector exposes no recovery with a zero HP allowance and one protected status item, exposes all three effects when live surplus exists, and removes HP after its allowance is consumed.

next_gate: Regenerate the source-bound registry, pass the full ROM-free gate, commit and push, then retry on a fresh uncounted diagnostic root.
